[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Solving questions with brainpower** [LC 2140 · Solving Questions With Brainpower](https://leetcode.com/problems/solving-questions-with-brainpower/){difficulty="Medium"}

This is house robber whose "skip the neighbour" has become "skip the next $b_i$ questions". Greedy fails both ways. Solving whenever you can on the second sample earns 4; the optimum is 7. Solving the richest question first on $[[5,3],[4,1],[1,1],[4,1]]$ earns 5 and blocks a schedule worth 8.
